comments.body: where can i find the trainer in venice?

comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: The carving up meat recipe is an excellent way to grind cooking, it would be impossible to believe until you try it out yourself, but while on the route I noticed some amiss....you give 2 chickens and a rabbit to the trainer, who then gives you raw meat in less than a second. There is no equipment visible, no chopper, nothing. What happened to the chickens and rabbits? I don't really want to know myself.
